passive.name: Ionian Fervor
passive.description: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.

primaryAbilities.name: Bladesurge
primaryAbilities.description: Irelia dashes forward to strike her target, healing herself. If the target is Marked or dies to Bladesurge, its cooldown refreshes.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Irelia dashes to an enemy, dealing {{ championdamage }} physical damage and restoring {{ healamount }} Health to herself. If the enemy dies or was Unsteady, the Cooldown is refreshed.

Deals {{ miniondamage }} damage to minions.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Defiant Dance
primaryAbilities.description: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to {{ maxduration }} seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by {{ finalphysicaldr }}% and magic damage taken by {{ finalmagicdr }}%.

Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing {{ mindamagecalc }} physical damage increased up to {{ maxdamagecalc }} based on charge time.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Flawless Duet
primaryAbilities.description: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate:
Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to {{ buffduration }} seconds.

Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for {{ stunduration }} seconds and dealing {{ totaldamage }} magic damage. Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for {{ markduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

primaryAbilities.name: Vanguard's Edge
primaryAbilities.description: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.
primaryAbilities.tooltipTemplate: Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing <magicDamage>{{ missiledamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and making champions and large jungle monsters <keywordMajor>Unsteady</keywordMajor> for {{ markduration }} seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for {{ zoneduration }} seconds. The cage deals <magicDamage>{{ zonedamage }} magic damage</magicDamage> and <status>Slows</status> by {{ slowamount }}% for {{ ccduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

allSpellRecords.name: Vanguard's Edge
allSpellRecords.summary: Irelia fires a massive number of blades that explode outward upon hitting an enemy champion. Enemies hit by the blades are damaged and Marked. Afterwards the blades form a wall that will damage and slow enemies that walk through it.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues: Irelia launches a barrage of blades, dealing [125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AP] magic damage and making champions and large jungle monsters Unsteady for [5 / 5 / 5] seconds. The barrage explodes into a cage around the first champion hit for [2.5] seconds. The cage deals [125 / 200 / 275 + (1) × AP] magic damage and Slows by [90 / 90 / 90]% for [1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5] seconds.

allSpellRecords.name: Ionian Fervor
allSpellRecords.summary: When Irelia strikes enemies with spells she gains stacking bonus Attack Speed. At maximum stacks she also gains bonus damage on hit.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Irelia gains a stack for [6] seconds when she hits an enemy with an Ability (max [4]). She gains [characterLevelInterpolation(10 → 25; raw flags preserved)]% Attack Speed per stack, and at max stacks her Attacks deal an additional [UNRESOLVED({b22609db}; see calculationRaw) + (0.2) × AD[statFormula=2]] magic damage.

Attacking a champion, structure, or large monster refreshes the duration of the stacks. Irelia gains a stack for each champion hit, or if she hits at least one non-champion enemy.

allSpellRecords.name: Flawless Duet
allSpellRecords.summary: Irelia sends out two blades which converge on each other. Enemies caught in between are damaged, stunned and Marked.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Irelia throws a blade into the ground and can Recast for up to [3.5 / 3.5 / 3.5 / 3.5 / 3.5] seconds. 

Recast: Irelia throws a second blade, then they fly towards each other Stunning for [0.75] seconds and dealing [70 / 110 / 150 / 190 / 230 + (1) × AP] magic damage. Champions and large jungle monsters become Unsteady for [5 / 5 / 5 / 5 / 5] seconds.

allSpellRecords.name: Defiant Dance
allSpellRecords.summary: Irelia charges a strike that deals more damage as she charges. She takes reduced physical damage during the charge.
allSpellRecords.tooltipWithSymbolicValues:
Begin Charging: Irelia enters a defensive stance for up to [1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5 / 1.5] seconds, becoming unable to act but reducing physical damage taken by [characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 70; raw flags preserved) + (0.08) × AP]% and magic damage taken by [(characterLevelInterpolation(40 → 70; raw flags preserved) + (0.08) × AP) × (0.5)]%.

Release: Irelia lashes out with her blades, dealing [10 / 20 / 30 / 40 / 50 + (0.4) × AD + (0.5) × AP] physical damage increased up to [30 / 60 / 90 / 120 / 150 + (1.2) × AD + (1.5) × AP] based on charge time.
